Remark
[Round-sphere concentration] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0123 1. ch29:29.34\group Backward Pressure Limit

For a round shrinking sphere the Euclidean conformal factor diverges at every fixed point as $t\to -\infty $, and every fixed disk captures asymptotically $4\pi $ of scalar curvature.
